instruction: Set up three local folders in Thunderbird named PROJECTS, ARCHIVE, and PERSONAL.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating three local folders (PROJECTS, ARCHIVE, PERSONAL) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder files and .msf index files exist for all three folders using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three required folders (PROJECTS, ARCHIVE, PERSONAL)
Postconfig appropriately uses 'ls -R' on Thunderbird's Local Folders directory to extract folder state
Metric function check_list with regex patterns correctly verifies presence of both .msf index files and folder directories
Complete coverage: all requirements in the instruction are verified
Regex patterns are functional but slightly complex - the pattern \bFOLDER/?(?!\.msf) should correctly distinguish folders from .msf files in ls output
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider simplifying regex patterns if possible, though current patterns should work correctly for standard ls -R output formats
